tspan.tspan: Write the wanted material, quantity, receiving site, requeste
d date, and the reason, then request approval.
Fix the reason or quantity and request again.
Decide the supplier, unit price, and expected receiving dat
e. For urgent or small-amount cases, it can be created dire
ctly without going through a request.
Check the amount and terms before approving. If sent back,
fix and request again.
Once ordered, it is treated as an expected receipt.
Record the quantity received, the date, and the receiving si
te.
The recorded receiving site's material stock increases as o
f the recorded receiving date.
When delivered in parts, record only what arrived; the rest i
s recorded as a later receipt.
Once the full ordered quantity has arrived, the purchase ord
er's status becomes "Received".
An outsource order is not created from purchasing — selecti
ng "Outsourced" as a work order step's execution location
makes it appear in the outsource order list.
